scope: Chosen narrative states and fixed-set majority/constant-rate arithmetic, not protocol model checking or native execution

stages.title: The current group
stages.history: Before purchase: P7 stock 1; order 103 absent
stages.note: A, B and C hold the current history. D has not joined this replica group.

stages.title: Copy a starting snapshot
stages.history: Purchase commits in the existing group: P7 stock 0; order 103 pending
stages.note: D copies a snapshot from before the purchase. Existing voters continue accepting work; a partial copy supplies neither a vote nor current authority.

stages.title: A complete copy can still be old
stages.history: D still has the before view: stock 1; order 103 absent
stages.note: The snapshot is installed, but the purchase is missing there. D must receive and apply the subsequent history. Its old stock is not permission for another sale.

stages.title: Catch up before changing voters
stages.history: D now includes purchase: stock 0; order 103 pending
stages.note: D has the required committed history. This establishes readiness in the drawing, not a new independent authority to write.

stages.title: Use a controlled transition
stages.membership: Joint: majority of A,B,C AND majority of B,C,D
stages.note: A committed joint configuration protects the transition. A majority of the four machines alone is not its rule. Leadership transfer also follows the protocol.

stages.title: Finish the new membership
stages.note: The final configuration is committed through the transition. A is removed from this group and has no independent write authority. Removal of an entire node must complete for all its groups.
